title: Evidence Record
description: The deterministic result of a single check run against an authoritative source. Stores the exact query, a hash of the raw response, what was observed, and the verdict, so anyone can re-run it.

check_id.description: Stable id of the check that produced this record, e.g. 'verify.junit_all_passed'.

claim_id.description: UUID of the claim this check was run for.

source.description: Authoritative source the evidence came from. Never a file an agent wrote in the same job.

query.description: The exact query/request made against the source.

response_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalized raw response, for reproducibility.

observed.description: The facts actually observed from the source.

subject_sha.description: Commit SHA this evidence applies to. Must match the claim subject.

subject_digest.description: Image digest this evidence applies to, if relevant.

reason.description: Short human-readable justification for the verdict.

tags.description: Optional tags, e.g. 'claim_mismatch' for a caught false claim.
